title: In the Pocket Cottage | Rosemary Beach Cottage Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: When looking for a place to stay for your beach vacation with your family, this beautiful Rosemary Beach cottage rental is the perfect accommodation. Book now!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to In the Pocket Cottage - Your Cozy Coastal Retreat!

Looking for the perfect home away from home? In the Pocket Cottage offers and inviting escape for families or small groups, blending character, comfort, and an unbeatable location on a serene pocket park in Rosemary Beach.

As you approach the home, you'll discover a delightful outdoor area featuring a small pool - the ideal spot to cool off on warm days. Nearby, you'll find an alfresco dining area, perfect for enjoying meals outdoors. Around the front, the cozy porch with a comfortable sitting area invites you to relax with a glass of wine or morning coffee while soaking in the peaceful park views.

Inside, the home welcomes you with a bright, open living space. The living room, featuring a plush couch and two chairs, flows seamlessly into the dining area, creating a perfect space for gathering. The kitchen exudes coastal charm with granite countertops and fresh white cabinetry, fully equipped to handle all your culinary needs. There is also a full bathroom on this floor, perfect for changing after spending time in the pool!

Venture upstairs to find inviting sleeping spaces. The serene master bedroom features a king-sized bed, an en-suite bathroom, and access to a private balcony - the perfect retreat after a day of exploring. The two guest bedrooms each have a queen bed, TV's and will use the shared guest bathroom on this floor.

But that's not all! This home now features a newly updated loft, providing a bonus living space with two twin beds for additional guests. This versatile area is perfect for extra guests, a quiet reading nook, or a play space for kids!

Driveway parking for two vehicles.

With its charming features, thoughtful layout, prime location on a pocket par, In the Pocket Cottage is ideal for those seeking a cozy, family-friendly getaway. Ready to experience the magic of this charming cottage? Contact Rosemary Beach at 866-348-8952 or visit us online to book your stay today!

Disclaimers:

Pool cannot be heated.

This property requires a 7 night minimum stay, Saturday to Saturday during spring break and summer and a 4 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
